d:
The Grizzlies defeated the Kings, 136-105 tonight in Memphis. Cameron Boozer finished with a team-high 27 points along with 9 rebounds and 3 assists for the Grizzlies, while Isaiah Stewart tallied 24 points, 4 rebounds and 2 three pointers in the game. Darius Acuff Jr. recorded 38 points, 9 three pointers and 5 rebounds. The Grizzlies improve their record to 6-0 with the win, while the Kings fall to 0-6 for the season.
